rules.eachFact: compare presence, value, status and source independently; duplicate field is invalid evidence
rules.missingTime: failure of time even if date is present
rules.countOnly: five entries never substitutes for matching identities and values
rules.mismatch: retain actual payload and classify first differing checkpoint; no automatic historical attribution
rules.comparisonInvalid: retain outcomes; withhold cross-arm causal attribution if setup equivalence is unproven

restoreEquality.scope: complete rows and exact column sets for declared conversation state, conversation revision, batch and all loaded context dependencies; schema-derived rowKeys/columnsByKey must be pinned before sealing
restoreEquality.representation: canonical JSON object keys; array order preserved; no omitted internal fields; bigint/numeric lossless strings; no exclusions within row data
captureTimes: source: committed state before export, writers stopped
target: after restore before invoking load RPC
optional persisted input reread before load: same scope; not the load RPC output
restoreEquality.predicate: all three canonical full-row snapshots equal within identical pinned scope; five facts checked independently as additional assertions
restoreEquality.witness: independent execution authority owns collector code/config/signing key; restore process exit status is not witness
limitations: snapshot collector and actual scope not yet built
EQUAL_IN_DECLARED_SCOPE is not historical attribution or whole-database equality

loadBoundary.reason: repository load RPC can upsert customer memory
stages: ACTUAL_LOAD_RESULT exact object handed to B
loadBoundary.rule: full-row equality checks pre-load persistence only; load-result differences are separate evidence and must not be treated as failed restore automatically
